claim: A cardiac surgeon's 30-second explainer on four blood-test numbers has 16k likes, 35k saves and 194 comments on Xiaohongshu — and the comments are not thanks. They are ordinary people pasting their own values and asking a stranger to read them. Under the same query what ranks is a how-to for getting an LLM to read your report, not a product.
method: Xiaohongshu search on 「体检报告 看不懂」 (logged-in browser; the result list and like counts are only visible in a screenshot, not in page text). Opened the highest-engagement note and scrolled the comment panel, reading comments off screenshots. Quotes verbatim in the original Chinese with province and relative date as displayed 2026-08-06.
does: Photograph your check-up report. Get back one thing — this week's grocery list, plus a swap-one-item-a-day table — instead of another explanation of what LDL means.
edge: Reading a Chinese hospital check-up sheet (dozens of labs, different reference ranges per hospital, scanned or photographed) into structured values is a multimodal task that only became reliable recently. The people in that comment section have already noticed: the top-ranking posts under this query are step-by-step guides to pasting your report into DeepSeek, which is the tell that the capability arrived and the product did not.
why_use: A person holding a printout with three numbers in red, who does not have a doctor to ask and will not book an appointment over a borderline lipid panel. What they walk away with is a shopping list they can use tonight — not a paragraph of explanation they will close and forget.
gap: The two sides never meet. Check-up products stop at translating the report into plain language; diet-logging products count calories and have never seen your lab sheet. The most-repeated request in Chinese comment sections is precisely the join — log what I eat and read it against my check-up — and the consensus about the incumbents (薄荷 / Cal AI / Caloris) is that they cover too little.
counter: This is health advice with a thin line under it, and the line is where the value is: the moment it says 'eat this' it is one step from dosing supplements and two from telling someone to skip a doctor. The honest version is deliberately smaller than the exciting version. Chinese super-apps and the check-up chains themselves already sit on the report at the moment of delivery, and diet-logging retention is famously awful — people log for eleven days.
differentiator: Do not build a health app. Build one artefact from one document: lipid panel plus fasting glucose in, a week's grocery list and a one-swap-a-day table out, with 'this is not a diagnosis — take abnormal values to a doctor' fixed at the bottom. No wearables, no long-term tracking, no medication. Cold start (Chinese): the 194 comments under that one note are already a list of named people asking, plus the 「体检报告 看不懂」 and 「怎么让AI解读体检报告」 queries; (English): r/Biohackers and r/nutrition threads where someone posts bloodwork and asks what to eat differently.
value: An adult who just did a company annual check-up and has three values in red — one payment per report, at the price of a takeaway meal, at the one moment per year they care.
risk: Medical scope creep is the failure mode, and the check-up chains hold the report first; diet logging has a retention floor that no amount of AI has yet lifted.

zh.claim: 一条心外科医生讲「体检报告上四个数字」的 30 秒科普，在小红书上 1.6 万赞、3.5 万收藏、194 条评论——而评论区不是道谢，是普通人把自己的化验值一条条贴出来，求一个陌生人替他看。同一个搜索词下排在前面的，是「怎么让 AI 帮我解读体检报告」的教程，不是产品。
zh.does: 把体检报告拍下来。只拿回一样东西——这周的买菜清单，加一张「每天只换掉一样」的替换表——而不是又一段解释低密度脂蛋白是什么。
zh.edge: 把一张中国医院的体检单（几十项、各家参考区间不同、还是拍的或扫的）读成结构化数值，是最近才靠得住的多模态活。评论区的人早就发现了：这个搜索词下排最前的是「把报告粘进 DeepSeek」的保姆级教程——能力到了、产品没到，这就是那个信号。
zh.why_use: 一个手里拿着三处飘红的单子、身边没有医生可问、也不会为一个临界血脂去挂号的人。他拿到的是今晚就能用的一张购物清单，而不是一段看完就关掉的解释。
zh.gap: 两边从来没接上。体检类产品把报告翻译成人话就停手；饮食记录类只数热量，根本没见过你的化验单。中文评论区里被重复得最多的诉求恰恰是这个接口——记录饮食后能对上体检报告——而对薄荷／Cal AI／Caloris 这类现有产品的共识是「覆盖不全、不够专业」。
zh.counter: 这是脚下画着一条细线的健康建议，而价值恰恰就在那条线上：一旦说出「吃这个」，离建议补剂剂量只有一步，离让人别去看医生只有两步。诚实的版本一定比激动人心的版本小。体检机构和国民级 App 在报告交付那一刻就已经握着它，而饮食记录的留存是出了名的差——人们记十一天。
zh.differentiator: 别做一个健康 App。从一份文件里做出一件成品：血脂四项＋空腹血糖进去，一周买菜清单和「每天只换一样」的替换表出来，末尾固定写着「这不是诊断，异常值请找医生」。不接可穿戴、不做长期追踪、不碰用药。冷启动第一步：中文＝那条笔记下的 194 条评论本身就是一份已经举手的名单，再加「体检报告 看不懂」「怎么让AI解读体检报告」两个词；英文＝r/Biohackers 与 r/nutrition 里贴 bloodwork 问「那我该改吃什么」的帖子。
zh.value: 刚做完公司年度体检、单子上有三处飘红的成年人——一份报告付一次费，价格对标一顿外卖，卖的是他一年里唯一在意这件事的那一刻。
zh.risk: 医疗边界的蔓延是主要失败模式；体检机构先拿到报告；饮食记录有一个至今没被 AI 抬起来的留存地板。
